# UTM

> UTM is a web design and development studio. UTM builds custom landing pages, corporate websites, and e-commerce stores, each shippable with a custom-trained AI chatbot embedded directly inside the site.

Website: https://www.utmsolutionsllc.online

## What UTM does

- Designs and builds custom, hand-coded websites (no drag-and-drop templates).
- Every build can ship with a custom-trained AI chatbot embedded in the site, trained on the business's own content, FAQs, and offers, to answer visitor questions and capture leads 24/7.
- Supports bilingual English/Arabic websites with full right-to-left (RTL) layout support, including a bilingual embedded chatbot.

## Services & starting prices (Standard / Pro)

- Landing Page (1-2 pages): $349 Standard / $549 Pro (Pro includes the AI chatbot). Delivery: 2-3 days Standard, 1-2 days Pro.
- Corporate Website (5-7 pages): $899 Standard / $1,299 Pro (Pro includes the AI chatbot). Delivery: 4-6 days.
- E-Commerce Website: $1,499 Standard (up to 10 products) / $1,999 Pro (up to 20 products, includes the AI chatbot). Delivery: 5-9 days.

Standard plans include a 14-day guarantee; Pro plans include a 30-day guarantee and a faster (72h vs 24h) revision window.

## Process

1. Discover & Design — map the business, audience, and goals; design blueprint-stage wireframes.
2. Engineer the Build — pixel-accurate development with performance, accessibility, and SEO built in.
3. Train the AI — the chatbot is trained on the client's real content, offers, and tone, then embedded in the site.
4. Launch & Support — the site ships, is monitored, and continues to be supported after handoff.
